name: Brunch at Time Out Market
description: For a relaxed Sunday, head to the stunning food hall in São Bento station. With a curated selection of 14 restaurants, it's the perfect spot to sample the best of Porto's cuisine under one roof.
longDescription:
This event offers a brunch experience at the Time Out Market, located within São Bento Station. The market is a food hall concept, featuring a selection of 14 restaurants and several bars. It aims to bring together a diverse range of Porto's culinary offerings in a single location, curated by Time Out's editorial team.

Visitors can expect a relaxed atmosphere suitable for a Sunday morning meal. The market is housed within the historic São Bento Station, known for its azulejo tilework. The experience allows for sampling various local dishes and beverages from different vendors. The duration of a visit is flexible, depending on individual preferences.

The Time Out Market operates on a walk-in basis, and reservations are not typically required for individual tables. São Bento Station is centrally located and easily accessible by metro (São Bento station on Line D), bus, and is within walking distance of many central Porto landmarks. The venue is generally accessible.
